site: The Mansion at Tuckahoe, 1707 NE Indian River Drive
about: Winterfest is one of the annual special events run by Martin County Parks and Recreation, alongside Fall Fest at Langford Park and the Music at the Mansion concert series.
The county pitches it as an easy all-in-one celebration for busy holiday schedules, with live entertainment, games and vendors in one evening.
The event is held at the outdoor amphitheater at The Mansion at Tuckahoe, inside Indian Riverside Park on the Indian River Lagoon in Jensen Beach.
County sponsor materials describe a variety of talent on stage, a visit from Santa, arts and crafts, face painting and food trucks.
The county reports that Winterfest draws more than 1,000 participants, so families can expect a full park.
The Children's Services Council of Martin County supports the event, and the county asks guests to bring friends and family and wear festive attire.
Two days later, on Sunday, December 13, the same venue hosts the free Music at the Mansion concert from 3 to 6 PM, with free games and activities for kids.
Questions go to the county special events team at events@martin.fl.us or (772) 221-1430.
The county's page notes that attendees may be photographed or filmed, and its hero images show crowds from earlier Winterfest nights at the Mansion at Tuckahoe.

kids: Watch Home Alone on a giant screen
Camp out on a blanket under the sky
about: Martin County Parks and Recreation runs six community movie nights each season at different county parks.
Each night uses a 20-foot LED screen set up outdoors, so the whole lawn can watch together.
The December 18 feature is Home Alone, the Christmas comedy about a boy defending his house over the holidays.
The county lists the evening from 5:30 to 8 PM at Wojcieszak Park, 4733 SE Group Ave, Stuart, FL 34997.
Food trucks open and begin serving at 5:30 PM, and the film itself starts at 6 PM.
Guests are asked to bring a blanket or lawn chairs for a relaxed outdoor movie experience for all ages.
Martin County describes its parks and recreation events as community driven and aimed at families, with local businesses sponsoring each movie night.
On the county's December calendar, the movie night follows Winterfest on December 11 and the Music at the Mansion concert on December 13, all in Martin County parks.
Guests settle on the lawn in front of the screen with their own blankets or chairs while the food trucks keep serving through the film.
faq: When is the Home Alone movie night in Stuart?
Friday, December 18, 2026, from 5:30 to 8 PM, with the movie starting at 6 PM.
Where is it?
Wojcieszak Park, 4733 SE Group Ave, Stuart, FL 34997.
Who hosts it?
Martin County Parks and Recreation, which runs six community movie nights each season.
What should we bring?
A blanket or lawn chairs for the lawn.
Will there be food?
Yes. Local food trucks open at 5:30 PM, half an hour before the film starts, so families can eat first and then find a spot on the lawn.
How big is the screen?
The county uses a 20-foot LED screen, the same one it sets up for its other movie nights in Martin County parks.

The county's movie night listing shows a date, hours and place, with no ticket amount shown.
